title: Seahawks free agency 2026: Another core special teamer set to return

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks free agency 2026: Another core special teamer set to return
sources.description: The big names - Ken Walker, Coby Bryant, Tariq Woolen and Boye Mafe - are gone, but nearly every free agent special teamer is set to return to Seattle.
